chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn Aamir, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Fazalat ibn Ayyub, from Al-Husayn ibn Uthman, from Amr ibn Abi Nasr, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'A man stands in prayer and intends to recite a chapter, so he recites 'Say: He is Allah, One' and 'Say: O you disbelievers'.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'He may return (break his recitation) from every chapter, except from 'Say: He is Allah, One' and 'Say: O you disbelieurs'.'

key_terms.قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ: Say: He is Allah, One (Surah Al-Ikhlas)
key_terms.يُرْجَعُ: He may return/stop (in the context of recitation)

ai.seo_question: Can I stop reciting a Surah halfway through during prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the principle of 'irja'' (returning) in prayer recitation, establishing that Surah Al-Ikhlas and Al-Kafirun possess a unique structural integrity that prohibits mid-recitation interruption. In Shia fiqh, this underscores the distinct legal status of these two chapters, often linked to their thematic completeness regarding Tawhid and Al-Takfir, making them indispensable for the validity of the recitation component of the prayer.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Abdullah Bin Aamir, from Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Al Husayn Bin Usman, from Amro Bin Abu Nazr who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘The man is standing during the Salāt, and he intends to recite a Chapter, so he recites ‘Say Heazwj Allahazwj is One’ (Chapter 112) and ‘Say: O you Infidels!’ (Chapter 109)’. So heasws said: ‘He can return from every Chapter except from ‘Say Heazwj Allahazwj is One’ (Chapter 112) and ‘Say: O you Infidels!’ (Chapter 109)’’.
en.sarwar: 25. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from as ibn ‘Amir from Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from al-Husayn ibn ‘Uthman from ‘Amr ibn abu Nasr who has said the following: “

I once said to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, that a man stands up for Salah (prayer), wants to read a Surah (chapter) and he reads Surah (chapter) 112 and Surah (chapter) 109. He (the Imam) said, ‘He can discontinue reading any Surah (chapter) except Surah (chapter) 112 and Surah (chapter) 109.’”
